blocks.text: Recognizing threats means identifying potential online dangers such as:

items: Phishing Scams: These are fraudulent attempts to obtain sensitive information by pretending to be a trustworthy entity. Example: Be cautious of emails that ask for personal details under the guise of an urgent request from a known organization.
Malware: Malicious software that can harm your computer or steal data. Example: Avoid downloading software from untrusted sources and ensure your antivirus software is up to date.
